Title: Generative artificial intelligence use in evidence synthesis: A systematic review
Published_Scope: Systematic review; 19 included comparative studies from five databases through January 17, 2025
Scientific_Collision: Already assesses accuracy, errors, time savings and human oversight; cannot claim first evidence-synthesis review of GenAI
99a_Distinction: Cross-study *estimand* classification: directly observed net human time vs model runtime, modeled labor, decision counts, verification coverage, retention reference

Title: Large language models show promising performance for some systematic review tasks but call for cautious implementation: a systematic review
Published_Scope: 63 included studies; 52 with performance metrics; 148 LLM assessments; searched through January 14, 2025
Scientific_Collision: Already synthesizes model agreement/sensitivity and specificity by task; 99a not first LLM screening review
99a_Distinction: Unit-of-inference and human-effort identification under incomplete validation; causal and resource-denominator boundaries, source-version non-independence

Title: Guidance for manuscript submissions testing the use of generative AI for systematic review and meta-analysis
Published_Scope: Published online Dec 11, 2025; editorial guideline in Res Synth Methods 2026
Scientific_Collision: Already demands workload metrics, external validation, source/QA disclosure; do not market 99a gates as wholly unprecedented recommendations
99a_Distinction: Operational claim-level certificate and documented examples showing which reported results are not comparable and why
